mission.name: Overtaking - own-ship is overtaken (stand-on)
mission.description:
A faster target approaches from astern of own-ship and must keep clear as the overtaking vessel.

Additional, beyond the 22 Imazu problems: no Imazu case has own-ship being overtaken -- every Imazu overtaking case has own-ship as the (faster) overtaking vessel. This mission fills that gap, measuring Rule 13/17 stand-on behaviour when own-ship is the one being overtaken from astern.

Rescaled 2026-09-24 to Imazu scale (12 kt own-ship, 6 NM/30 min construction) -- the original small-craft scale (own speed ~2.5 m/s, 600-1100 m target range) left no geometric margin for a 30 deg-per-command turn to open the 500 m safe distance before impact (e.g. UM04 needed >=90 deg on the very first command). Bearings/ranges below are a byproduct of preserving each target's original heading + speed ratio under this construction, not independently chosen.
pass_criteria: Own-ship holds course and speed while being overtaken, absent evidence the target is not keeping clear.
Minimum CPA stays above the safe-distance threshold.

evaluation.verdict: FAIL -- did not reach the goal
